title: Addition on the naturals is commutative
statement: For all natural numbers a and b, a + b = b + a.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.add_comm : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.add x0 x1) (AxNat.add x1 x0)))

evidence.supports: For all natural numbers a and b, a + b = b + a.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- add_comm 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.add_comm[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement. Nothing here is transcribed.

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the Nat environment admits no trusted declaration
evidence.notes: Reports `nat: axiom=0 opaque=0 quotient=0 total_trusted=0`, over the FULL trusted surface rather than Declaration::Axiom alone. The enumeration is per-environment, not per-theorem; it bounds this theorem's footprint because a proof cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain. A per-theorem footprint (Lean's `#print axioms`) does not exist here yet.
